I am a marine biologist working at the intersection of population
genomics, bioinformatics, and animal movement ecology.

My research combines genomic and acoustic telemetry data to investigate
marine populations and inform conservation and fisheries management.

## Research interests

- Population and conservation genomics
- Acoustic telemetry and animal movement
- Molecular identification and DNA barcoding
- Reproducible bioinformatics
